dominant_strengths: Clear hierarchy with proper indentation distinguishing folders, sub-folders, and system categories
Native macOS integration maintains expected Finder sidebar patterns and interactions
Functional organization groups related items logically (Favorites, iCloud, Locations, Tags)
dominant_weaknesses: Harsh blue highlight (#007AFF) creates jarring contrast against dark theme, breaking visual harmony
Inconsistent iconography mixing filled, outlined, and colored icons without clear system logic
Generic dark theme lacks personality or innovation beyond standard macOS appearance
fix_priorities: Replace aggressive blue selection with subtle gradient or muted accent color
Unify icon system with consistent weight, style, and selective color usage
Add subtle depth through shadows or layering to improve spatial hierarchy
Introduce custom touches while maintaining native feel (micro-animations, refined spacing)
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral design (clear navigation) undermined by weak visceral appeal (harsh colors, flat execution) and minimal reflective value (no memorable qualities).
rationale.intent_fit: Successfully implements functional file management but lacks the polish and innovation expected from modern file browsers.
